title: Uniqueness of the approximate tangent plane of a rectifiable varifold
statement: For all n, ℓ, every rectifiable n-varifold V in ℝ^{n+ℓ}, every x ∈ ℝ^{n+ℓ} and all linear subspaces P, Q: if V.IsApproxTangentAt x P and V.IsApproxTangentAt x Q (each: the subspace is n-dimensional and, for some constant c > 0, t⁻ⁿ∫ f(t⁻¹(y − x)) dμ_V(y) → c∫ f dHⁿ over the subspace as t ↓ 0 for every f ∈ C_c), then P = Q.
lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (V : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ) (x : Ambient n ℓ) (P Q : Submodule ℝ (Ambient n ℓ)), V.IsApproxTangentAt x P → V.IsApproxTangentAt x Q → P = Q
